title: Réseau
description: Network of this computer: live throughput of the main interface (download / upload, Mbit/s) and latency (ms) to the Internet (1.1.1.1) and to the gateway, with packet loss; main connection (interface, Wi-Fi network, signal, band, channel, security, IPv4/IPv6, gateway, MAC, link speed); DNS (servers, search suffixes, a timed resolution test, local cache size on Windows); DHCP lease; physical interfaces; visible Wi-Fi networks; neighbors (ARP table: IP, MAC, interface); IPv4 routes; listening TCP/UDP ports with their process; established TCP connections; active VPNs; shared folders, mapped drives and network mounts; system proxy and custom hosts file entries; and a traceroute to 1.1.1.1 refreshed every 10 minutes. Findings flag no connection, packet loss, high latency, DNS failures, weak or insecure Wi-Fi, a slow Ethernet link, a proxy and custom hosts entries.

functions.name: ping
functions.title: Ping
functions.description: Pings a host (name or IP) from this computer: each reply with its time, then sent/received counts, loss and min/avg/max time. Use it to check whether a host is reachable and how fast.

parameters.name: target
parameters.label: Cible
parameters.description: Host name or IP address to ping.

parameters.name: timeoutMs
parameters.label: Délai (ms)
parameters.description: Timeout of each ping, in milliseconds.

functions.name: traceroute
functions.title: Traceroute
functions.description: Traceroute from this computer to a host: each hop with its address and latency. Use it to see where a connection slows down or stops. Takes up to a few seconds per hop.

functions.name: test_port
functions.title: Test de port TCP
functions.description: Tests a TCP connection from this computer to host:port and reports whether the port is open, closed (refused) or filtered (no answer), with the connection time. Use it when ping is blocked or to check a service (web, SSH, RDP, SMB…).

functions.name: test_mtu
functions.title: MTU du chemin
functions.description: Measures the path MTU from this computer to a host: the largest packet that passes without fragmentation (1500 on a normal Ethernet path, less behind PPPoE or a VPN).

functions.name: get_public_ip
functions.title: Adresse IP publique
functions.description: Public IPv4 and IPv6 addresses of this computer as seen from the Internet, with their reverse DNS name. Calls the external service api.ipify.org.

functions.name: discover_lan
functions.title: Découverte du réseau local
functions.description: Discovers devices on the local network: pings every address of the main subnet (up to a /24), then lists each device with IP, DNS or mDNS name, MAC address, role (this computer, gateway), mDNS services (printer, Chromecast, SMB share, Home Assistant…) and ping time. Takes 2 to 5 seconds.

parameters.name: timeoutMs
parameters.label: Délai du ping (ms)
parameters.description: Timeout of each ping, in milliseconds.

functions.name: resolve_dns
functions.title: Requête DNS
functions.description: DNS query from this computer: records of a given type (A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, NS, TXT, SOA, PTR, SRV) for a name, optionally against a specific DNS server, with TTL and response time.

parameters.name: name
parameters.label: Nom
parameters.description: Name to resolve (or IP address for PTR).

parameters.name: server
parameters.label: Serveur DNS
parameters.description: DNS server to ask (IP or name); omit for the system resolver.
